# Eriselda's Salon & Boutique

> Hair salon based in Hutto, Texas. Cuts, color, balayage and Brazilian blowouts in Hutto, from stylists who listen first. Family-owned since 2010 and a Best of Hutto winner for Best Hair Salon.

- Phone: (512) 759-9970
- Based in: Hutto, TX
- Nearby areas: Hutto, Taylor, Round Rock, Pflugerville, Georgetown, Manor
- Google rating: 4.8 from 151 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/eriseldas-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/eriseldas-salon/book.html

## Services
- Cuts for the whole family: Women's, men's and kids' cuts. Clients say the stylists here listen first, then cut exactly what you asked for, from a dusting off the ends to a first haircut.
- Color & root touch-ups: All-over color, root touch-ups, gloss and deep conditioning, customized to how you actually wear your hair every day.
- Highlights & balayage: Partial and full highlights and hand-painted balayage, from soft honey and caramel to bright blonde.
- Vivid color: Pinks, violets, reds and teal. Bold color is a regular thing in this chair, not a special request.
- Brazilian blowouts & smoothing: Ofelia does Brazilian blowouts that take curly, frizzy hair to smooth and shiny.
- Styling, extensions & more: Shampoo and style, Dream Catchers extensions, wig trims and facial waxing.

## About
Eriselda Johnson opened her salon in Hutto in July 2010. It lives in a teal house at 103 Jim Cage Ln with a white oval sign out front, and inside you'll find teal walls, hardwood floors and a chandelier in the lounge. Some of Eriselda's clients have been in her chair since the day she opened. Ofelia Castillo brings more than 24 years in the industry and speaks Spanish and English, and Martha rounds out the team. Each stylist rents their own booth and sets their own hours, so you always know exactly who is doing your hair. Hutto noticed: Eriselda's won Best Hair Salon in the Best of Hutto awards. The salon also looks after its neighbors, with discounted cuts for the adults at Nu Day next door. As one client put it: a Ritz Carlton experience with a welcoming and homely feel.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment?
  A: Appointments are best, since each stylist keeps their own schedule. If a stylist is free you can walk in, and consultations are always free. Call (512) 759-9970 to check.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Tuesday and Wednesday 10 AM to 6 PM, Thursday and Friday 10 AM to 8 PM, Saturday 10 AM to 5 PM. Closed Sunday and Monday. Hours can vary by stylist, so call to book.
- Q: Does anyone speak Spanish?
  A: Yes. Ofelia Castillo is bilingual (Spanish is her first language) and explains every service and its price before she starts. ¡Se habla español!
- Q: How much does color cost?
  A: Eriselda's price list is on this page, with balayage starting at $200 and root touch-ups at $75 to $95. Every stylist rents their own booth and sets their own prices, so ask your stylist for a quote at a free consultation.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids' cuts are on the menu, and first haircuts are welcome.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 103 Jim Cage Ln, Hutto, TX 78634: the teal house with the white oval Eriselda's Salons sign.
